about.title: About
about.intro: Larbi brings together online courses, a tutorial blog and business tools for freelancers and companies (sole traders, SMEs) on a single platform.
about.approachBody: Each course is organised into lessons, with progress tracking and a certificate issued once the completion conditions are met. Blog content is publicly accessible, with some of it reserved for premium accounts depending on the user's profile.
about.securityBody: Protecting accounts and content (videos, images, documents) is a priority: access permissions are checked server-side, and proprietary content is never exposed publicly without prior verification.

services.title: Services & offers
services.intro: Three main areas, accessible depending on your account type and access level (standard or premium).

formations.title: Courses
formations.body: Structured lesson paths, progress tracking and a certificate at the end of the course. Requires an account.

blog.title: Blog & tutorials
blog.body: Public articles, with premium content recommended based on your profile.

tools.title: Business tools
tools.body: Credit simulator and PDF/Excel invoice generator. Requires an account and depends on your access rights.

items.question: What account types exist?
items.answer: The platform manages several profiles (sole trader, SME, industrial SME, with more categories to be added later), each with a standard or premium access level.

items.question: What's the difference between a standard and a premium account?
items.answer: Your account's level determines which content and features you can access: some articles, courses or tools may be reserved for premium accounts.

items.question: Is the blog accessible without an account?
items.answer: Yes, the blog is publicly accessible. Courses and tools, on the other hand, require you to be logged in and depend on your access rights.

items.question: How does course certification work?
items.answer: A certificate is issued only once all of a course's completion conditions are met, with verification performed server-side.

items.question: Are my content and media protected?
items.answer: Access to proprietary content (videos, images, documents) is controlled server-side. No web solution can fully prevent the copying of content that is displayed, but the platform strongly limits the possibilities for direct retrieval.

features.intro: Access to each area depends on being logged in and, for some content, on your account's level (standard or premium).
features.footNote: This table reflects the access rules already defined for the project. The real check is always enforced server-side, never only in the interface.

formationsPresentation.title: Courses
formationsPresentation.body: Each course is made up of a defined number of lessons. Your progress is tracked lesson by lesson and course by course, and a certificate is issued once all completion conditions are met.
formationsPresentation.accessNote: Accessing courses requires being logged in and depends on your access rights.
formationsPresentation.notice: The course catalogue, enrolment and lesson playback will be available starting in Phase 2 (E-Learning — tasks P2-01 to P2-07).

invoice.title: Invoice generator
invoice.body: Create invoices (client, provider, products/services, totals) with PDF and Excel export.

toolsPresentation.accessNote: Accessing the tools requires being logged in and depends on your access rights.
toolsPresentation.notice: The tools will become usable in Phase 4 (tasks P4-01 to P4-05), once authentication and roles are in place.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.notice: The exact details of the processing (precise purposes, retention periods, sub-processors, DPO contact if applicable) must be validated with the client before publication. The principles below only reflect rules already agreed in the project's requirements.
privacy.dataBody: The platform limits the personal data collected to what is genuinely necessary to manage accounts (sole trader, SME, industrial SME, etc.), track courses and use the tools.
privacy.securityBody: Access to accounts, courses, premium content and proprietary media (videos, images, documents) is checked server-side. IDs sent to the API are always checked against the logged-in user and their permissions.
